sources.h1: King Tone Guitar HeavyHand V2 Overdrive / Distortion
sources.excerpt: King Tone Guitar HeavyHand V2 Overdrive / Distortion Guitars & Basses Keyboards Percussions Orchestra DJ Center Recording & Video Live Equipment Lifestyle Used en €   Sign in Cart Search Home / Guitars & Basses / Effects / Pedal Effects King Tone Guitar HeavyHand V2 Overdrive / Distortion King Tone Guitar Ref KTGHH2 The Heavy Hand is a powerful overdrive pedal that delivers thick, chewy drive tones with exceptional sustain Ask for info Out of Stock Ask for info Features King Tone Guitar HeavyHand V2 This pedal offers a transparent, open sound stage without the usual mid-hump found in many overdrives. If green pedals aren’t your thing, this is an overdrive monster you’ll love. New Features Include: Exact Original Heavy Hand Circuit, Now with Added Features. Soft FootSwitch Amp-Like Mode – Produces a Cranked Amp Tone KingTone Setting Fattens The Tone And Adds Edge Bite For a Unique Massive Tone Distortion Mode – Adds a Distortion Clipping Circuit, giving the Heavy Hand a tube’y, Marshall-esque style gain Stage Symmetrical/Asymmetrical Gives the overall tone of the pedal a warm, characterful , Harmonic Rich Tone. RGB LED – Set The LED To Any Color Protected Knobs – No More Cables Or Feet Messing With The Settings But Still Easy To Adjust. External Dip Switches For Easy Fine Adjustment Custom Designed CNC 6061 Aluminum Case Description The HeavyHand is Side “B” Of the Duellist The HeavyHand is the side B of the Duellist pedal. It features the same high-quality components and pristine tone. Additionally, the HeavyHand has several unique features, including a dedicated control for the “Body” setting. This control allows users to dial in the precise amount of added low-end to the tone. Furthermore, there’s an “Edge” setting that enables users to add an edgy, tube-like quality to the tone. Moreover, you can now make adjustments to the pedal’s clipping section. New dip switches let you adjust the symmetry for gritty, harmonic rock lead tones. The “Amp-Like” setting provides a wide open sound stage with enhanced dynamics and chunkiness. The “KingTone” setting alters the overall voicing of the pedal, giving it an edgy bite in the top end, while the low end offers a tube-like chug tone. Perfect for humbuckers or single-coil pickups alike, this pedal delivers the sustain and rich harmonics you’ve been seeking.
